card.name: Repeated or stray opening quotation marks
card.fires_on: A quotation mark (curly or straight) that appears right after another quote mark, or where a quote seems doubled or misplaced. It is seen in titles, quiz questions and schedules.

modes.label: Doubled opening quote
modes.description: A second opening quote mark placed right after an earlier one or before a title.
modes.example: On what Caribbean Island was the “<< “>> Proclamation?

modes.label: Quote closing a quoted term
modes.description: A curly quote that closes or sits next to a short quoted term in running text.

modes.label: Quote inside code string
modes.description: A straight quote in a code print statement after a label.

card.plain: It fires on quotation marks that are doubled, stray or oddly spaced around titles and quoted terms.
